OverriddenModel.title: OverriddenModel is the control: an explicit annotation still wins over the recognizer.

blob.description: Blob says what the bytes are, so the recognizer must not overrule it.

StreamModel.title: StreamModel carries every recognized stream type as a model field.

Writer.description:
Write writes len(p) bytes from p to the underlying data stream.
It returns the number of bytes written from p (0 <= n <= len(p))
and any error encountered that caused the write to stop early.
Write must return a non-nil error if it returns n < len(p).
Write must not modify the slice data, even temporarily.

Implementations must not retain p.
Writer.title: Writer is the interface that wraps the basic Write method.

WriterModel.description:
An API payload does not plausibly contain an `io.Writer` — a sink the caller writes into is not
something that goes on the wire. Recognizing it would be inventing an intent, so it keeps
whatever the structural walk makes of it and the author overrides if they meant something.
WriterModel.title: WriterModel holds the type deliberately left OUT of the recognized set.

streamResponse.description: StreamResponse returns a stream as the response body.

XChecksum.description: XChecksum is a stream reached through a response header.
